source: Sole local PG17 schema catalogue, no business rows/RPC calls

installed.identityArguments: p_candidate_id uuid, p_after_legacy_case_id uuid, p_limit integer, p_sort text
p_actor_user_id uuid, p_kind text, p_args jsonb

indexes.name: bpay_next_stored_credit_amount_cursor_v1
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX bpay_next_stored_credit_amount_cursor_v1 ON public.pay_advances USING btree (candidate_id, original_amount, id) WHERE ((case_type = 'MANUAL_CREDIT_ADJUSTMENT'::pay_finance_case_type_enum) AND (taxability = 'NON_TAXABLE'::pay_finance_taxability_enum) AND (routing_kind = 'ONE_OFF_SPECIFIED_BANK_ACCOUNT'::pay_finance_routing_kind_enum) AND (oneoff_bank_details_required IS TRUE) AND (status = 'ACTIVE'::pay_advance_status_enum) AND (payout_status = 'PENDING'::pay_advance_payout_status_enum))

indexes.name: bpay_next_stored_credit_created_cursor_v1
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX bpay_next_stored_credit_created_cursor_v1 ON public.pay_advances USING btree (candidate_id, created_at, id) WHERE ((case_type = 'MANUAL_CREDIT_ADJUSTMENT'::pay_finance_case_type_enum) AND (taxability = 'NON_TAXABLE'::pay_finance_taxability_enum) AND (routing_kind = 'ONE_OFF_SPECIFIED_BANK_ACCOUNT'::pay_finance_routing_kind_enum) AND (oneoff_bank_details_required IS TRUE) AND (status = 'ACTIVE'::pay_advance_status_enum) AND (payout_status = 'PENDING'::pay_advance_payout_status_enum))

indexes.name: bpay_next_stored_credit_payee_prefix_cursor_v1
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX bpay_next_stored_credit_payee_prefix_cursor_v1 ON public.pay_finance_case_oneoff_payout_bank_details USING btree (candidate_id, "left"(beneficiary_name, 128) COLLATE "C", finance_case_id)
